$doc: The platform's text, a device of the app's ABI beside the UI's protocol
(ui.json): what the core calls of it, numbered as ui.json numbers its
own, each a call the runtime answers beside the core before it returns
(ts/client/src/runtime/start.ts, ts/client/src/service/core/text.ts). Where an answer lies in the
core's memory is laid out in spec/client/core/sys/io/text_answer.json.
name: text

import.name: TEXT_LAYOUT
$doc: The text in the platform's own family at the weight and size, broken into lines no
wider than the width where it can be; at `at` in the core's memory, how many lines,
then a line's end (a byte offset) and its width (f32) apiece, `lines` of them at most
(sys/io/text_answer.json LAYOUT_ANSWER, LINE). A call: answered before it returns.

pkt.name: text_at
$doc: Where the text's UTF-8 lies in the core's memory: by address, so a text longer than a slot crosses whole, and kept until the call returns.

pkt.name: text_len
$doc: The length of that UTF-8 in bytes.
